title: JavaScript Certification Test (Chapter 1.1 & 1.2)
instructions: You have only one chance to attempt this test. Once submitted, it cannot be retaken.

questions.text: A developer writes: let total = 10 + 5 * 2; console.log(total); What will be printed?

questions.text: Which statement about strict mode is TRUE?
